verdict.rationale: A live OpenAPI 3.1 spec titled 'Superset API' is publicly served at api.superset.sh/openapi.json, and the product llms.txt indexes it along with an API-scoped llms.txt. That gives a machine-readable API reference, but nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples. Docs-domain OpenAPI paths 404, and the SDK and CLI docs only describe capabilities. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference UI (try-it or playground), runnable request examples, and any hands-on corroboration of an explorable reference.
